title: PIPE-03: the Jacobian on fMRIPrep's own field map, on the MNI grid
alt: Axial slices on the MNI152NLin2009cAsym 2 mm grid of OpenNeuro ds005040 sub-002's distortion-correction Jacobian: fMRIPrep's factor, larmorx's corrected factor and the reference (the factor on the BOLD's own grid carried to this grid), then each factor's error against the reference on a symmetric scale.
